description: Verify that TCP in FIN-WAIT-2 honours RECEIVE calls and ACKs incoming data while remaining in FIN-WAIT-2 (RFC 793 §3.5 p38)
approach:
[Objective]
FW2 is FW1 + the peer's ACK of DUT's FIN. The half-open direction is still readable; DUT must continue to ack incoming data and stay in FW2 until the peer FINs.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Handshake → CLOSE → FW1 → tester ACKs DUT FIN → FW2.
2. Tester → DUT: data segment.
3. Observation: DUT acks data, no FIN/RST emission, stays in FW2.

[Pass condition]
DUT acks data + remains in FW2.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack / Fail_no_dut_fin — prelude broken
• Fail_no_dut_data_ack — DUT did not ACK in FW2
• Fail_dut_left_fw2 — DUT emitted FIN or RST (illegal in FW2)
• Fail_no_proper_data — wrong payload reported

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked data and stayed in FIN-WAIT-2 — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_dut_data_ack: No DUT ACK to received data in FW2
verdicts.Fail_dut_left_fw2: DUT emitted FIN or RST in FW2
verdicts.Fail_no_proper_data: DUT did not receive proper data in FW2
